items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... And Zimbaki. Yeah. Now, what tunes would you play for a show?

ctx.x: When I was Bunky, I worked at the Festelle maybe about, about a year. About a year then the thing began to get kind of slow with him. So we came back in. Thank you. So when he came back in, I went to the old, back to the old folks home. Left her for a time and went back. I left Luchin and went out in Bunky. Come back from Bunky and went back to Luchin. So I stayed in Luchin until I got sick.
Was that the club play time? Yeah. That's right. I don't know how it went. That's right. That's right. And Zimbaki. Yeah. Now, what tunes would you play for a show?
Oh, what tune I played for the show? He played, what number? See, what the thing? I was thinking of the thing.
